title: C17 write scope -- shell verb table

all_args.description: Verbs whose every path argument is a write target (mkdir, New-Item, rm, Out-File...)

last_arg.description: Verbs whose destination is the last positional argument (cp, Copy-Item, mv...); robocopy/xcopy use the second

named_params.description: Parameters whose value is a write target (-Destination, --output, --basetemp...)

script_extensions.description: A script file the command runs is read and checked with the same table
